routes.title: For the Peace We Once Sought

rows.en: The two GEARs and the Data Weapons... I cannot let all of them fall into their hands...
rows.notes: Context: Spiral Castle addresses the machine generals about losing both GEARs/Data Weapons. Decision: restore first-person refusal and retain threat trailing ellipses.

rows.en: Yes...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Even if I must use my own body... to smash that planet to pieces.
rows.notes: Context: continuation of row0 refusal; target planet revealed by row4. Decision: retain that planet rather than reveal Earth early; explicit I preserves self-sacrifice threat.

rows.en: Then, Oyakata-sama...
rows.notes: Context: Giga Witter responds to the drastic threat. Decision: source deliberately trails off; protected title Oyakata-sama retained.

rows.en: Prepare Spiral Castle for launch... Our target... is Earth...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: ...And that is the outline of Operation Bagration.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Operation Bagration... That was the Soviet Union's massive counteroffensive during the world war of the last century.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri identifies the historical operation for briefing participants. Decision: restore explanatory predicate That was; no invented numbered world war.

rows.en: Incidentally, it was named after General Pyotr Ivanovich Bagration, who served in Imperial Russia.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri continues historical explanation. Decision: preserve complete personal name and Imperial Russia; provisional name spelling pending orchestrator provenance. Orchestrator verified Operation Bagration using US Army Press historical study and full personal name through Columbia Encyclopedia; Pyotr follows source-standard romanization.

rows.en: Then this operation is also a counteroffensive?
rows.notes: Context: Bright asks whether current Bagration also refers to a counteroffensive; Misumaru confirms in row9. Decision: restore predicate established by adjacent explanation.

rows.en: That's right. We've secured considerable numbers of Dragoons and mass-produced mobile suits, too...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: The Federation will commit its full strength to attacking the bases of Gulfer, the Vegan Empire, the Giganos remnants and the Martian Successors.
rows.notes: Context: Misumaru enumerates four enemy formations. Decision: preserve every faction and full-strength attack, canonical Gulfer and Vegan Empire.

rows.en: So we're taking out the enemies in space first.
rows.notes: Context: Bright privately draws strategic implication; original FULL11 has thought brackets although fresh source labels dialogue. Decision: preserve immutable fresh kind for checker; report source-kind discrepancy.

rows.en: A little verse for the occasion... "In the cool breeze, even the bugs grow restless... the great decisive battle"...
rows.notes: Context: Misumaru inserts a haiku leading into Ruri bug/Bagration criticism. Decision: retain cool breeze, restless insects and decisive battle plus bug sound cue; English not forced into 5/7/5.
uncertain: Haiku pun rendered literally; weak bugs/Bagration sound connection retained, exact syllabic form not reproduced.

rows.en: I see. Insects... bugs... Bagration? That's a bit of a stretch.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri explains and criticizes Misumaru pun. Decision: ordinary bugs are insects, not character Bug; preserve weak bugs/Bagration phonetic joke.

rows.en: Hmm... You're a tough critic, Ruri.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: So, when does the operation begin?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: In about a week. Naturally, you'll be taking part in this operation as well.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Understood, sir.
Spiral Castle... has completely separated from the moon. It has begun moving at the same time...
rows.notes: Context: Meteo interrupts briefing with motion report. Decision: restore report verbs and retain separation/movement simultaneity.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Its course...!? Where is Spiral Castle heading!?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Spiral Castle is heading for Earth. Estimated arrival in twelve hours.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Captain Bright, I'll send the Federation fleet to intercept it immediately. Prepare to launch your forces at once, too.
rows.notes: Context: Misumaru orders Bright to launch after Earth trajectory alarm. Decision: Captain Bright is sourced naval rank; restore I send/you prepare distinction.

rows.en: Understood!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: We've finished installing the system in Dendoh's left cockpit.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Can this really let one person pilot Dendoh?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Dendoh and Ogre were originally the same.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: My brother could pilot Ogre alone because it mechanically generated the power that comes from synchronizing Dendoh's two pilots.
rows.notes: Context: Vega explains deceased brother Altair single-pilot mechanism. Decision: brother referent established in rows32/36 and character profiles; keep mechanically generated synchronization power.

rows.en: So, if we install a similar system, one person can pilot Dendoh as well.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Gulfer will probably throw everything it has into the next battle...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Then we have to meet it with everything we have, too... That's why we'll be using Ogre.
rows.notes: Context: Vega proposes deploying captured Ogre in response to all-out attack. Decision: we refers to her force, not Vega personally piloting Ogre; next rows decide Hokuto.

rows.en: So... Ginga, Hokuto, who's piloting which one...?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: I'll... pilot Ogre.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Eris addresses distressed Hokuto; deliberate name fragment.

rows.en: Altair is Mom's older brother... That makes him my uncle...
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto volunteers for uncle Altair robot. Decision: explicit maternal elder-brother relationship and uncle retained.

rows.en: That's why I'll pilot it.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Then it's settled. You can leave Dendoh to me.
rows.notes: Context: Ginga accepts Hokuto choice. Decision: source offers own Dendoh piloting; leave Dendoh to me appropriate direction.

rows.en: Yeah... Let's give it our all, Ginga!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: ...Thank you, Hokuto... I'm sure my brother will be happy, too...
rows.notes: Context: Vega thanks Hokuto silently for choosing uncle robot. Decision: my brother refers to Altair; no speculative death wording added.

rows.en: Dendoh and Ogre... Two GEARs and six Data Weapons... Now that's a sight to see.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: We'll win... won't we...? Even against Spiral Castle...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Don't worry, Eris.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Yeah! We'll join forces! We're gonna smash it for sure!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: I'm counting on you, Ginga and Hokuto... The only way to stop Spiral Castle is to break inside and attack the reactor at its center.
rows.notes: Context: Vega tasks the boys with penetrating Spiral Castle. Decision: I am counting on you is request to boys; retain only way and central reactor target.

rows.en: The Federation's mobile suit and metal armor squads will disrupt the enemy's vanguard...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Then #部隊名 breaks straight through the center. That's the plan.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: We're calling it "Operation Screw Nail"... We're the tip of that screw.
rows.notes: Context: Vega names tactic after central thrust. Decision: provisional Operation Screw Nail; retain screw-tip metaphor; ignore documented stray source closing bracket.
uncertain: Operation Screw Nail missing in loaded glossaries; source-literal wording pending provenance.

rows.notes: Silent reaction preserved.

rows.en: What's wrong, Ginga...?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Hey... Vega. Can I... go out for a little while?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Context: Vega reacts to Ruri; interjection retained. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: ...We repeat: An evacuation advisory has been issued worldwide as Gulfer's Spiral Castle approaches.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Please follow police and Federation instructions and evacuate to your nearest shelter. We repeat...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Come on, Otome... Are you ready? It's time we went to the shelter.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Hey, Mom... Where's Big Brother Gin?
rows.notes: Context: Otome asks Midori about absent brother. Decision: Big Brother Gin preserves kinship nickname rather than guessing absent pronoun.

rows.en: Gin is...
rows.notes: Context: Midori about to answer Otome when Ginga arrives FULL56. Decision: intentionally unfinished predicate preserved.

rows.en: Mom...
rows.notes: Intentional address-only fragment.

rows.en: Ginga...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Big Brother Gin! It's Big Brother Gin!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Heh... I haven't seen you in a while either, Otome...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga first greets mother off-packet FULL56, then little sister. Decision: either preserves Otome too as another family member he has not seen for a while; complete spoken predicate restored.

rows.en: Big Brother Gin...
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Hm?
rows.notes: Context: both original uses read, FULL61 reacting to Otome address and i074b86 replying to mother Gin call. Decision: neutral Hm? works in both.

rows.en: Why are you wearing dancing clothes?
rows.notes: Context: Otome mistakes GEAR suit for dancing clothes. Decision: retain mistaken interpretation, restore you wearing.

rows.en: Huh...!? No, I'm not!! This is...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga denies Otome dancing-clothes interpretation and begins explanation. Decision: This is remains intentionally unfinished.

rows.en: Hm?
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Th-this is... No... Um, well...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga flusters before confessing piloting secret. Decision: stammer and unfinished This is preserved.

rows.en: I'm... actually Dendoh's...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga begins revealing Dendoh role; mother interrupts FULL68. Decision: Dendoh possessive left deliberately unfinished, no pilot supplied early.

rows.en: Ginga...! I knew... Your mom knew all along...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: What...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: But you never told me... You kept it a secret...
rows.notes: Context: Midori explains withholding disclosure while son kept secret. Decision: you subject restored; trailing ellipses preserve broken emotional delivery.

rows.en: But I thought... someday you'd tell me...
rows.notes: Context: Midori continues why she waited. Decision: I thought restored; ellipses preserve emotional trailing speech.

rows.en: I'm so glad, Ginga... I'm really so glad...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.
Leo Circle remains silent across repeated appearances.
Silent Gatling Boar at both emergence and villain recognition; no added speech.

rows.en: Wow! It's Mr. Lion and Mr. Piggy! Big Brother Gin, you kept your promise!
rows.notes: Context: Data Weapons Leo Circle/Gatling Boar enter silently FULL73/74; Otome recognizes promise. Decision: childish Mr. Lion/Mr. Piggy labels instead of revealing technical names.

rows.en: Yeah. It's not a stuffed animal... but it's still a lion. And Boar isn't a pig. It's a wild boar.
rows.notes: Context: Ginga distinguishes living Data Weapon from promised stuffed lion and corrects animal name. Decision: protected short Boar; wild boar contrast fully retained.

rows.en: Nice to meet you, Mr. Lion! Mr. Piggy-Boar!
rows.notes: Context: Otome greets Data Weapons, still mixing pig and boar. Decision: Mr. Piggy-Boar reproduces deliberate animal mix; greeting requests friendly acquaintance, not reversed reliance imperative.
uncertain: Childish Piggy-Boar hybrid nickname source-literal; no established English title verified.

rows.en: I'm heading out with these guys and Hokuto... and everyone in #部隊名.
rows.notes: Context: Ginga says farewell to family. Decision: these guys denotes two Data Weapons present; nickname placeholder retained unexpanded.

rows.en: I'll beat them and come back, I promise...
rows.notes: Context: Ginga promises to defeat enemies and return. Decision: them enemies known from evacuation/battle briefing; explicit I and come back retained.

rows.en: Go get 'em, Big Brother Gin!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Yeah!
Gin...!
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Um... You remember, don't you...? What your mom told you...
rows.notes: Context: Midori checks remembered maxim at farewell. Decision: you remember/I told relationship restored; two spoken clauses retain pause.

rows.en: Strength comes from the heart...!
rows.notes: Context: Midori gives family maxim; Ginga repeats next row. Decision: same provisional natural maxim used identically twice.
uncertain: Maxim source-literal; no licensed English quotation verified.

rows.en: Strength comes from the heart...!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga repeats maxim before checking correctness next row. Decision: exact same wording as mother.
uncertain: Maxim source-literal; no licensed English quotation verified.

rows.en: Right?
rows.notes: Context: Ginga checks repetition of maxim. Decision: deliberate short confirmation Right? retained.

rows.en: ...Yes. Don't you lose. You make sure you come home.
rows.notes: Context: adjacent original scene turns checked; audience and reply follow source. Decision: natural complete spoken English with source tone and pauses.

rows.en: Yeah, I promise!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga accepts mother return instruction. Decision: explicit I promise; ignore known stray final bracket/control artifact.

rows.en: Everyone, fall in! Attention!
It has been a long time, Gandal. And you too, Zuril, Barendos.
King Vega, welcome to Skull Moon Base.
Yes.
By the way, King Vega... Our preparations to conquer Earth are nearly complete. Why have you come here now?
Indeed. You could have waited comfortably on Planet Vega for the good news...
rows.notes: Intentional unfinished suggestion; no completion supplied.

rows.en: ...We have lost that Planet Vega.
W-what!?
King Vega! What did you just say!?
I shall say it again... Our home, Planet Vega, has vanished from this universe without a trace.
It can't be...! What in the world happened to Planet Vega!?
...Look at this.
This is... Zeta 4, Planet Vega's satellite...
rows.notes: Intentional recognition fragment; Zeta 4 follows root terminology research.
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: It is the source of the Veganium ore that supplies most of Planet Vega's energy.
rows.notes: Retains ore and majority energy supply; Veganium remains distinct from Vegatron.
uncertain: Veganium ore uses the source-literal mineral plus ore. Secondary specialist reference corroborates Veganium spelling; exact licensed ore term unverified. Distinct from Vegatron.

rows.en: Yes. But on Zeta 4, something happened that should never have been allowed to happen.
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: S-surely not...!?
Indeed it did. An accidental explosion occurred in one of the Vegatron mines...
rows.notes: Intentional trailing sentence leading into the chain reaction.

rows.en: A chain reaction set off one mine after another. Finally, Zeta 4 itself exploded into fragments.
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: Th-then, Planet Vega...!?
rows.notes: Intentional shocked question trailing off before Vega answers.

rows.en: Zeta 4's explosion showered the surface with radioactive Vegatron dust... Planet Vega became a dead world.
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: N-no... That's impossible...!
And it did not end there.
...What do you mean, Your Majesty?
We took refuge underground for the time being, but above ground, Zeta 4's destruction caused all manner of disasters...
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: Then the fires reached the Vegatron storage facilities left on the surface, and the planet met the same fate as Zeta 4.
uncertain: Zeta 4 is a source-literal satellite name/number; exact established English localization unverified. Arabic 4 preserves the source without an invented Roman numeral convention.

rows.en: Th-then...!?
rows.notes: Intentional shocked fragment, not omitted English pro-drop.

rows.en: Explosion after explosion tore through Planet Vega, until it was reduced to debris in space.
After that, I gathered the survivors... and came here to Skull Moon Base.
Then we are the last survivors of Planet Vega...!?
Yes. With no homeland left to return to, we must make Earth our own, whatever it takes.
But what is the situation now...?
Duke Fleed and his allies have kept our conquest of Earth crawling along at a snail's pace!
W-well... There are various reasons for that...
At this stage, I have no patience for excuses.
M-my deepest apologies.
I hear that Gulfer's Spiral Castle has now begun to move...
Duke Fleed and his allies are likely in a panic over intercepting it...
Therefore, we cannot let this perfect opportunity slip away.
I understand. As commander of the front lines, I shall personally take them on.
Wait, Gandal. As Captain of the Royal Guard, that duty belongs to me.
Hmph... After all your failures, can either of you truly dispose of Duke Fleed?
Grr...
Ugh...
I shall entrust this operation to the man I have brought with me.
...Pardon me, King Vega.
Mors...! You're alive!?
It has been a long time, Captain Barendos.
So this is Mors...
Yes, Gandal. You have heard the rumors, have you not?
Yes... Mors, prince of the now-lost Planet Mole and a member of the Royal Guard...
rows.notes: Intentional identifying fragment responding to the rumor question.
uncertain: Planet Mole follows the existing glossary; that glossary explicitly marks the location romanization unverified.

rows.en: But I heard he and his machine, Jigajiga, were caught in a space storm during a mission and went missing...
But Mors lived. He returned with Jigajiga, which meteors and cosmic rays had reduced to a skeleton...
rows.notes: Skeleton describes Jigajiga, not Mors; meteors and cosmic rays both retained.

rows.en: Yes, this man returned alive from the darkness of space.
...You give me far too much credit.
rows.notes: Modest response to royal praise; idiomatic rather than literal shame.

rows.en: Mors, your loyalty and indomitable spirit make you worthy to lead the Royal Guard...
Therefore, I appoint you Captain of the Royal Guard.
W-what!? Then what becomes of me...!?
rows.notes: Restored what becomes of me while preserving unfinished shock.

rows.en: You are dismissed. Confine yourself to quarters for the time being.
Me, Captain of the Royal Guard... I humbly accept this honor, far beyond what I deserve.
...Mors, you understand the role you must fulfill, do you not?
Yes, sir. I must defeat Duke Fleed, who destroyed my Planet Mole and now defies you, King Vega, the man who saved my life...
rows.notes: Mors repeats implanted belief; not corrected to objective history. Sentence trails into next row.
uncertain: Planet Mole follows the existing glossary; that glossary explicitly marks the location romanization unverified.

rows.en: That is my mission.
Yes. Go, then, Mors! On your honor as Captain of the Royal Guard, you must defeat Duke Fleed!
That will repay me more than anything else could!
Yes, sir! Even at the cost of my life, I shall defeat Duke Fleed, who threatens the peace of the universe.
Heh heh heh... A dependable man indeed.
King Vega... I cannot accept this decision...!
Barendos is right. Mors is the prince of Planet Mole, which our Vegan Empire conquered...
rows.notes: Intentional setup fragment continued in row150.
uncertain: Planet Mole follows the existing glossary; that glossary explicitly marks the location romanization unverified.

rows.en: And he was Duke Fleed's closest friend...
rows.notes: Intentional continuation of row149 identifying Mors; kept as fragment.

rows.en: Why appoint a man who could betray us at any moment to command the attack?
No... There is no need to fear that.
As Zuril says, Mors's loyalty to me is absolute. Because...
rows.notes: Because trails off for Rubina to reveal the cause in row154.

rows.en: Because Father rewrote Prince Mors's mind...!
rows.notes: Father is King Vega; mind-rewriting revealed only at this row.

rows.en: Rubina...!
Oh... Princess Rubina. You have come as well?

rows.notes: Silence shared across three distinct points; neutral ellipsis.

rows.en: King Vega, is what Princess Rubina said true?
Yes. Three years ago, when our forces conquered Planet Mole, I took its prince, Mors, prisoner.
uncertain: Planet Mole follows the existing glossary; that glossary explicitly marks the location romanization unverified.

rows.en: But he was too valuable a man to simply kill...
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: So I ordered Zuril to plant false memories in Mors's mind.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: ...That Duke Fleed had destroyed Planet Mole.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: False-memory claim preserved as a continuation of 161, not narrator fact.
uncertain: Planet Mole: retained existing glossary spelling; independent romanization is unverified.

rows.en: And Mors came to believe that I had saved his life...
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Deliberate trailing clause links to 164; Mors is the subject of the belief.

rows.en: He came to hate his dear friend Duke Fleed from the bottom of his heart.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Yes. The mind control we imposed on him is flawless.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: But, King Vega... Duke Fleed has joined forces with those Earthlings.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Their power is certainly not to be underestimated, sire.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Have no fear. I have a second scheme in place.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Two-layer scheme retained; no additional mechanism invented.

rows.en: If Mors fails, I'll simply have him take Duke Fleed down with him.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Mutual destruction intent retained; no invented bomb mechanism.

rows.en: Oh... Duke...
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Where do you think you're going, Rubina?
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: I'm going to see Duke. That's why I came to Earth.
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Absolutely not! That man is an enemy of the Vegan Empire!
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: No! He is still as dear to me as he ever was!
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Rubina, do you still have feelings for that man...?
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Unfinished emotional question retained with ellipsis.

rows.en: Then I have all the more reason not to let you go!
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Princess Rubina, this way...
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Let go of me! I... I have something I must tell him!
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Rubina refers to Duke, established at 172 and named at 180.

rows.en: Something you want to tell him?
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: Father! Please stop fighting him... Stop fighting Duke Fleed!
rows.notes: Context: King Vega's court; memory manipulation, Rubina, and Barendos deployment. Decision: Natural spoken wording; source force, referents, and row boundary retained.

rows.en: ...Take her away.

I'm a full-fledged pilot too! I can't lose to some fake!
I won't forgive you... I won't! Great was built to protect peace, and you're using it as a tool of evil!
Making friends bound by deep bonds fight each other... I won't forgive you!
Love, friendship, trust? How can anyone believe in such things? What rules this world... is power!
You who drown in power... Feel the strongest force in this universe upon your own body... justice!
rows.notes: Rom ceremonial register and direct address retained; justice is revealed at end.

rows.en: Then I'll teach you a lesson too! Justice isn't power... Power is justice!!
I hate the way you try to make friends fight each other!!
Heh... Don't you understand? People killing each other like that is the finest entertainment for us.
You... rotten bastard! Like hell I'll go along with your sick idea of fun!!
Making friends fight each other...

You idiot! Even if that happens, I'll never abandon Hokuto!!
Neither will I!!

I hear you! I've never forgotten the voice of the man who destroyed our home planet, not for a moment!
Wake up, Mors! I didn't destroy Planet Mole! The Vegan Empire did!
rows.notes: Planet Mole follows glossary unverified romanization; Vegan Empire is the culprit, Duke denies responsibility.
uncertain: Planet Mole romanization is unverified in the glossary.

Have you forgotten...? That Planet Fleed and Planet Mole were on friendly terms...
rows.notes: Planet Mole follows glossary unverified romanization; historical diplomatic friendship retained.
uncertain: Planet Mole romanization is unverified in the glossary.

rows.notes: Mutual study abroad and mutual advanced-science learning both retained.

rows.en: Wha... t?
Mors, remember! We studied together, played together, and became irreplaceable best friends!
You and I were best friends...!?
That's right, Mors! When the Vegan Empire attacked Planet Fleed, you were with me!
I-I was on Planet Fleed...!?
Before you escaped to Planet Mole, we swore that we'd both survive and meet again...
rows.notes: Planet Mole follows glossary unverified romanization; both survival and reunion retained.
uncertain: Planet Mole romanization is unverified in the glossary.

rows.en: Mors, have you forgotten that promise!?
S-shut up! Trying to confuse me won't do you any good!!
Mors!

No. If it's some form of mind control... a powerful shock might break the hypnotic suggestion.
rows.notes: Conditional mind-control diagnosis and possibility retained; does not assert a guaranteed cure.

That time?
Do you mean back at the Robot Museum?
Yeah, that's right!
...Though I'm hardly in a position to talk big about it.

rows.en: B-but how...!?
Mors... We swore we'd meet again, there in those flames...
To keep that promise, I'll take a gamble too!
A gamble...!?
Yes. I'll defeat that Vega Beast! I'll gamble on the shock restoring Mors's memory!
rows.notes: Explicit gamble, machine defeat, shock, and memory-restoration causality retained.

rows.en: Wait! If this goes wrong, he'll die!
I won't let that happen...! I'll save Mors, no matter what!
All right...! If you're that determined, I'll help you too.

rows.en: That'll make things harder for us later, then.
But whatever the situation... that would be the same, wouldn't it?
True enough.
Then let's all go along with Daisuke's gamble!
Either way, this whole operation is a huge gamble...

Besides, we can't just leave the rest of the Vegan Empire alone.
Everyone...!
...Our top priority is still to break through this sector. Daisuke, I'll leave that pilot called Mors to you.

Yes, sir!
Now that we've settled that, let's go, Duke Fleed! Let's save your friend!
